title: Synchronizing Spectral and Interference Criticalities at an Exceptional Point
summary: Exceptional points (EPs) are spectral singularities, but whether they can be used to control a distinct criticality of coherent interference remains largely unexplored. Here we show in nonlocal superconducting transport how spectral and interference criticalities can be controllably synchronized. In a minimal superconducting double-quantum-dot system, loss imbalance selectively drives one Bogoliubov sector through an EP.
